body:
## Best gifts for book lovers at a glance

- **Best overall:** Kindle 32GB (newest generation, no ads), £139.99 at Amazon
- **Best cheap:** Glocusent clip-on book light, £7.99 at Amazon
- **Best budget e-reader:** Kindle 16GB (2024), £84.99 at Amazon
- **Best for kids:** Kindle Kids (2024), £89.99 at Amazon, down from £159.99
- **Best for library borrowers:** Kobo Clara BW, £109 at Currys
- **Best splurge:** Kindle Scribe Colorsoft, £439 at Amazon

## How to choose a gift for someone who loves books

**Do they already have an e-reader?** If they read on a Kindle that's a few years old, an upgrade to the new aluminium Kindle or a Colorsoft is a real step up: faster page turns, a sharper and brighter screen, and USB-C charging. If they've just bought one, don't buy another. A case, a book light or an Audible membership is the better gift.

**Paper or screen?** Some readers will never switch from paper, and that's fine. For them, a clip-on book light is the most useful thing under £10 you can buy, especially for someone who reads in bed next to a partner. A National Book Tokens gift card lets them choose their own books at almost any UK bookshop.

**Kindle or Kobo?** A Kindle is the easy choice for most people: Amazon's store is the biggest, Kindle Unlimited works only on Kindle, and the hardware is excellent. A Kobo makes more sense for someone who borrows ebooks from the library, because Kobo has OverDrive built in, or who buys ebooks from shops other than Amazon. Kindles can now borrow library books in the US but not in the UK.

**Colour or black and white?** Colour E Ink (Kindle Colorsoft, Kobo Clara Colour) is lovely for comics, graphic novels, cookbooks and magazines. For novels, black and white looks slightly sharper and costs less. If they mainly read fiction, save the money.

**Do they write as well as read?** The Kindle Scribe range adds a pen for notes, journalling and marking up documents. It's a big screen and a big price, so it suits students, writers and people who read work PDFs rather than someone who reads a novel on the bus.

## Good prices to aim for

These are the prices we'd be happy paying, based on PriceSpy's price history and this month's deals:

- **Kindle 16GB (2024):** under £85 is fair; £79.99 is the lowest it has been.
- **Kindle 32GB (newest):** £139–£140 is its three-month low.
- **Kindle Kids (2024):** under £90 is a strong price; it has touched £84.
- **Kindle Paperwhite Signature Edition:** it was £139.99 earlier in November. At £229.99, wait.
- **Kindle Scribe Colorsoft:** £439 is £190 under its full price.

Amazon's Black Friday Week runs until Cyber Monday, 30 November. Kindle offers on Amazon usually end on or just after Cyber Monday, and several of the prices above are listed as running until 1 December. After that they tend to go back up until the next Prime event. If a Kindle is on your list, buy it this week.

Free Prime delivery helps if you're buying close to Christmas, and some Amazon deals are for Prime members only. A [Prime free trial](/guides/amazon-prime-free-trial-black-friday-2026/) covers you through December.

## Gifts that cost almost nothing

**Audible.** If the person you're buying for says they never have time to read, audiobooks are the answer. Audible's current offer is £0.99 a month for three months for eligible members, plus a £10 bonus. You can also send an Audible membership as a gift from Amazon. Our [Audible free trial guide](/guides/audible-free-trial-deals-uk/) explains what you get and how to cancel.

**Kindle Unlimited.** For a fast reader who gets through several books a month, Kindle Unlimited gives access to a big library of ebooks and some audiobooks for a monthly fee, and new members usually get a free trial. It's worth it for genre fiction fans (thrillers, romance, fantasy); less so for someone who wants this year's prize winners. See our [Kindle Unlimited guide](/guides/kindle-unlimited-free-trial-uk/).

Still deciding between models? Our [Kindle vs Kindle Paperwhite comparison](/guides/kindle-vs-kindle-paperwhite/) goes into the differences, and there are more ideas in our [Christmas gift guides](/christmas-gifts/).

## FAQs

### What is the best Kindle to buy as a gift?

For most readers, the new Kindle 32GB without ads at £139.99. It's light, has a sharp 300ppi screen and is at its three-month low. On a tighter budget, the 2024 Kindle at £84.99 is still a very good e-reader.

### Can you gift a Kindle book or Audible membership?

Yes. Amazon lets you send a Kindle ebook to someone's email address, and Audible memberships can be bought as gifts on Amazon. Both are useful last-minute presents because nothing needs posting.

### Is a Kobo better than a Kindle?

Not better, just different. Kobo suits people who borrow library ebooks or buy from several stores. Kindle suits people who already use Amazon's store or want Kindle Unlimited.

### When will Kindle prices drop again?

Amazon's Kindle deals usually end around Cyber Monday (30 November) and come back at the next big sale, often a spring sale or Prime Day in the summer. If you want one for Christmas, this week is the time to buy.
